description: This file defines the ConsumerBase class, a base class for BufferQueue consumer endpoints in Android's graphics framework. It manages buffer connection, state, and event notifications, and declares related classes, methods, and data structures.

classes.name: ConsumerBase
classes.description: A base class for BufferQueue consumer endpoints, managing buffer connection, state, and event notifications.

classes.name: ConsumerBase::FrameAvailableListener
classes.description: Listener interface for frame availability and related events.

classes.name: ConsumerBase::Slot
classes.description: Data structure representing a buffer slot, including buffer, fence, and frame number.

methods.name: abandon
methods.description: Frees all buffers and puts the ConsumerBase into an abandoned state where further operations fail.

methods.name: isAbandoned
methods.description: Checks if the ConsumerBase is in the abandoned state.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets a name for the ConsumerBase for identification in logs.

methods.name: dumpState
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the ConsumerBase to a string.

methods.name: setFrameAvailableListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for frame availability events.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from a specified slot.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the default buffer size (width and height).

methods.name: setDefaultBufferFormat
methods.description: Sets the default pixel format for buffers.

methods.name: setDefaultBufferDataSpace
methods.description: Sets the default data space for buffers.

methods.name: setConsumerUsageBits
methods.description: Sets usage bits for the consumer.

methods.name: setTransformHint
methods.description: Provides a transform hint for buffer orientation.

methods.name: setMaxAcquiredBufferCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of buffers that can be acquired.
